AG U.S. Missions per-missionary giving surface EXISTS and is national: https://usmissions.ag.org/MissionaryLocator/USMissionaryResult?Account=<numeric account id> (live examples seen: Account=2687374, Account=2871937, Account=2A40652). AG documentation confirms 'Account Holders can grab the URL from their giving page to share a direct link to give to their account.' This is a QUERY-STRING + OPAQUE NUMERIC ID form, so per the wave rules it is NOT a hit and no record here is graded on it - but it is the single highest-value structural find for Chi Alpha and the whole AG U.S. Missions family (Chi Alpha, Youth Alive, MAPS, Intercultural Ministries). It needs a fetch pass or an account-id enumeration pass, not a search pass.

Chi Alpha campus sites cluster on two repeatable domain shapes: (a) <campus/state>chialpha.com/.org - alabamachialpha.com, auchialpha.org, eiuchialpha.org, dcchialpha.com, chialpha.org (Wisconsin/N-Michigan district); (b) <campus>xa.com / xa<campus> - mostatexa.com (Missouri State), mizzouxa.com (Mizzou), semoxa.com (SE Missouri State), pnwxa.org (Pacific Northwest district).

Campus/district staff rosters live at a FLAT, repeatable path - /staff, /our-staff, /our-staff-2, /who-we-are, /about-us - never at a per-person slug. Confirmed instances: auchialpha.org/staff, pnwxa.org/staff/, mostatexa.com/our-staff, mizzouxa.com/our-staff, semoxa.com/our-staff-2/, chialpha.org/about-us, alabamachialpha.com/who-we-are. Giving is likewise flat: /give, /giving, /donate-1. NO Chi Alpha local was found serving org.org/staff/<first>-<last> or give.org/<first>-<last>. The federation's repeatable pattern is a roster page per local, not a page per person - so the whole federation is a staff_directory/medium harvest by search, and only a fetch pass over these flat roster URLs converts it to volume.

chialpha.com (national) - orientation only, as briefed. Has /about/national-leadership/, /staff/coaching/coaches/, /staff/healthy-leaders/ roster pages naming national staff. No per-person surface. Giving routes to the National Chi Alpha Ministry Center and to giving.ag.org.

directory.chialpha.com - a Chi Alpha chapter directory exists at this subdomain (landing seen: /Directory/BlankPage). It appears to be an app-rendered chapter locator, not a person index, and did not expose indexable per-chapter URLs to search. Worth one fetch-pass probe to see if it enumerates the federation's local sites - that list would seed a full local-site sweep.

alabamachialpha.com (Univ. of Alabama) - explicitly states 'All Alabama Chi Alpha staff are U.S. Missionaries who are independently funded by the financial contributions of individuals, churches and businesses' and that each is AG-ordained. Strong Tier A org_policy evidence for the whole federation, but its /who-we-are roster did not surface staff names to search. Prime fetch-pass target.

auchialpha.org (American University, DC) - MINED. /staff roster and /give page. /give states staff 'are each responsible for support-raising their salaries from personal contacts'. Roster names Blane Young (Director) in full; two further staff are published with FIRST NAMES ONLY (Natalie, Jolene), which is a recurring Chi Alpha roster habit and caps yield from these pages.

dcchialpha.com - DC Chi Alpha (serves American Univ. and Georgetown, ~1,500 students). Has campus-scoped giving pages /go-page-gu and /go-page-au, but these are MISSION-TEAM giving pages keyed to campus, not to person. No staff names surfaced.

pnwxa.org - Pacific Northwest Chi Alpha district. Rich staff-support infrastructure (/MPD, /CMIT, /LIGHT, /resources/storm/ - STORM is their donor-development tracker), confirming district staff do MPD. /staff/ is a flat roster; only Jonathan Lytle (Regional Director) surfaced by name.

chialpha.org - Wisconsin / Northern Michigan district (WINM Chi Alpha). Flat Wix-style site: /about-us, /our-mission, /locations, /contact-us. /locations may enumerate the district's campus chapters and is worth a fetch pass. Named Joshua and Heather Ernst as district directors. NOTE: the bare domain chialpha.org also serves unrelated spam paths (e.g. /category/asyali-sikis) - treat non-www paths on this domain with care.

mostatexa.com/our-staff (Missouri State), mizzouxa.com/our-staff, semoxa.com/our-staff-2/ - three Missouri campus rosters confirmed to exist. mostatexa.com publishes staff with FIRST NAMES ONLY (Kara, Missions Director; Andrew and Kristi, International Life Directors), so no emittable records. Fetch pass needed for mizzouxa and semoxa.

eiuchialpha.org (Eastern Illinois) - /donate-1 states staff are required to raise their own personal monthly support and directs donors to www.giving.ag.org (search-by-name), i.e. the local site deliberately has no per-person giving page. This is the federation's standard handoff and is the structural reason Chi Alpha was deferred.

needs_review.issue: The federation's per-person giving surface is national, but query-string and numeric-ID keyed
needs_review.finding: Chi Alpha locals do not host per-person giving pages. They uniformly hand donors to giving.ag.org / usmissions.ag.org and tell them to search the missionary's name. AG U.S. Missions does issue each missionary a shareable personal giving URL of the form https://usmissions.ag.org/MissionaryLocator/USMissionaryResult?Account=<id>.
needs_review.evidence: Live examples in search results: Account=2687374, Account=2871937, Account=2A40652. AG giving help PDF (usmissions.ag.org/-/media/USMissionsV2/Districts/Giving-Helps2024.pdf) states account holders can grab the URL from their giving page to share a direct give link. eiuchialpha.org/donate-1 and pnwxa.org/giving/ both route donors this way.
needs_review.recommendation: This is the whole-federation unlock and it is a fetch/enumeration job, not a search job. Two options: (1) fetch the MissionaryLocator search endpoint filtered to Chi Alpha and harvest name+account pairs, which would cover every Chi Alpha campus missionary nationally in one pass and also unlock the other AG U.S. Missions ministries; (2) if the locator is filterable by ministry, treat account ids as the person key and grade medium per the numeric-ID rule unless the response body carries the name. Do NOT re-run this as a search-only wave - three of my searches confirmed search cannot see inside it.

needs_review.finding: auchialpha.org/staff carries 'Natalie' and 'Jolene' with bios but no surnames; mostatexa.com/our-staff carries 'Kara' (Missions Director) and 'Andrew and Kristi' (International Life Directors) with no surnames.
needs_review.evidence: Search summaries of http://www.auchialpha.org/staff and https://www.mostatexa.com/our-staff.
needs_review.recommendation: Not emitted - first-name-only is a hard exclusion. These are not anonymized-for-safety cases (no sensitive-region signal), just informal campus-ministry roster style, so a fetch pass may recover surnames from email addresses or bio text on the same pages.
